lines.text: The ministry of death, engraved on stone, came with such glory that the Egyptians could not gaze at Moses' face.
The ministry of the Spirit and of righteousness is more glorious than what was fading away.
With such a hope, Paul and those with him are very bold, unlike Moses, who veiled his face.
To this day a veil covers their hearts when Moses is read, but turning to the Lord removes it.
Where the Spirit is, there is freedom, and those with unveiled faces are being given a new name.
